title: The Blaschka Object Network — Global Archive Register
scope: Named archival collections, record groups, manuscript series, accession registers and institutional archives with demonstrated or high-priority relevance to Blaschka objects, orders, distribution, custody or afterlives. Object repositories without a specific archival trail are excluded until a usable source series can be named.
flattening_note: The seven entries formerly held in global-archive-register-supplement-2026-08-10.json were appended without changing their record values. The historical supplement is preserved under archive/data/.

status_vocabulary.direct_blaschka_archive: The archival unit explicitly names Blaschka or is a dedicated Blaschka archive.
status_vocabulary.dealer_business_archive: Business archive of a documented Blaschka dealer or distributor.
status_vocabulary.direct_receiving_side_archive: Museum or institutional records explicitly document a Blaschka transaction, custody event or collection.
status_vocabulary.receiving_side_archive: Archive is directly tied to a Blaschka-holding institution and contains the relevant class of acquisition, accession, correspondence or museum records, but the decisive Blaschka item remains to be isolated.
status_vocabulary.candidate_archival_bridge: A named personal or institutional fonds is historically well positioned to close a known provenance gap, but a Blaschka-specific item has not yet been verified.
status_vocabulary.direct_blaschka_archive_target: A named archive is tied to reported direct Blaschka evidence, but the decisive archival item still requires retrieval or shelfmark confirmation.
status_vocabulary.candidate_direct_institutional_bridge: A named institutional series is directly positioned to test a documented Blaschka relationship, but the decisive item has not yet been isolated.
status_vocabulary.comparative_institutional_archive: A named institutional archive is retained as a controlled comparison and is not itself treated as direct Blaschka evidence.
status_vocabulary.direct_receiving_side_archive_target: A receiving-side archive is strongly tied to a documented Blaschka transaction, but the decisive local record still requires retrieval.
status_vocabulary.candidate_personal_archival_bridge: A named personal fonds is well positioned to close a documented provenance or chronology gap, but a Blaschka-specific mention has not yet been verified.
status_vocabulary.dealer_business_comparator: Dealer business records are retained as controls for commercial practice but are not themselves direct Blaschka evidence.

entries.repository: Österreichisches Staatsarchiv, Allgemeines Verwaltungsarchiv
